723.00 Unnumbered road. The sign indicates that the road has no number and is not maintained by the Icelandic Road and Coastal Administration.
723.13 Road number. The sign indicates the number of the road. On white direction signs the road number symbol is yellow.
723.14 Road number, route to a road. The sign indicates that the road leads to another road with the specified number.
723.41 Tourist destination with Vörðu certification. The sign indicates an interesting tourist destination that meets the Vörðu criteria set by the Ministry of Tourism.
723.42 UNESCO World Heritage Site. This sign indicates a destination on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
723.51 Abandoned farm. The sign indicates that a direction sign with the symbol points to an abandoned farm.
